title: Signer Order Is Address Order
summary: MODEL LIMIT. The Safe checks the first threshold signatures in address order (Safe.sol 338); playground and harness addresses differ (chain: Carol < Erin < Dave < Alice < CoSigner < Bob < Mallory), so extra or context-tail signers fall differently.
lesson: Found by differential fuzzing; expectations are the on-chain outcome. Engine: GS026, GS026, ok.
engine: The outcome depends on the order of the signers' real addresses, which differ between the playground and the Hardhat run (the Safe checks signatures in ascending address order).

steps.label: Alice, Carol and Mallory sign (threshold 2): on chain Carol < Alice < Mallory, so Mallory is not checked
Carol signs, Alice is read from the context tail: on chain Alice > Carol, so the pair is in order
Alice signs, Carol is read from the context tail: on chain Carol < Alice, out of order
